summary: Comprehensive testing of Unified Register Linkage System V2 - All critical features verified: availability endpoint, task creation with P1/P2/P3 only, cross-collection conflict detection, task auto-zero cron, and grade sync on task submission.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All unified register linkage features are working correctly. Key test results: 1) GET /api/register/availability returns period_name, period_active, availability with assigned_to type/id/title. 2) EM column is taken by exam 'Examen Mensual - Test Auto Zero'. 3) POST task with register_column=EM/EB returns 400 (tasks only P1/P2/P3). 4) Cross-collection conflict detection works (task occupies P1 -> exam with P1 returns 409). 5) Delete task releases column. 6) POST exam without period_id auto-resolves active period. 7) Task auto-zero cron: creates task with past due_date -> after 65s task status=closed, submissions have auto_zero=true with grade=0, student_grades has part_pX=0. 8) Grade sync on task submission works: grading a task submission syncs vigesimal value to student_grades.part_pX. Frontend: PremiumTaskModal shows bimester-badge with 'BIMESTRE I ACTIVO' (read-only), task-register-linkage-block with P1/P2/P3 only (no EM/EB). ExamModal shows bimester-badge with 'BIMESTRE I ACTIVO' (read-only), register-linkage-block with all 5 columns (EM/EB/P1/P2/P3).

backend_api_tests: GET /api/register/availability - returns period_name, period_active, availability with assigned_to
EM column shows as taken by exam
POST task with register_column=P1 creates task linked to register
Cross-collection conflict: task occupies column -> exam with same column returns 409
Delete task releases column (availability shows column available again)
POST exam without period_id auto-resolves active period
Task auto-zero cron: task with past due_date -> status=closed after 65s
Task auto-zero cron: submissions array has auto_zero entries with grade=0
Task auto-zero cron: student_grades has part_pX=0
Grade sync: grading task submission syncs to student_grades.part_pX
frontend_ui_tests: PremiumTaskModal: EM/EB options correctly NOT present (tasks only P1/P2/P3)
